{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values (e.g., negative ages, ages above 120)
sentinel_mask = (sales_df['customer_age'] < 0) | (sales_df['customer_age'] > 120)
sentinel_rows = sales_df[sentinel_mask]

# Display the sentinel rows
sentinel_rows[['customer_age', 'order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'status', 'revenue', 'converted']]"}
